Order
% 20.05.2025 Cm Appl. 11948/2025 (interim directions)
1.
The petitioner has filed the present application seeking interim directions.

2. As the penalty imposed in the present case pertains to withholding of two annual increments without cumulative effect, it entails only financial consequences, which can be remedied in the event the petitioner succeeds in the writ petition.

3. The application is, therefore, disposed of, with the observation that any financial benefits withheld from the petitioner on account of the impugned order will be subject to the result of the writ petition.
